agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic TGF-beta-imprinted NK cell therapy (cell therapy), intratumoral via Ommaya reservoir
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Natural killer (NK) cells are immune cells that recognize and get rid of abnormal cells in the body, including tumor cells

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult (1-39 y) recurrent malignant brain tumour trial; gliosarcoma named in inclusion criteria among several brain tumour types (incl. non-glioma sarcoma and ependymoma), coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (alternatively basket_gbm_eligible; both are include categories). Only intervention is a cell therapy, so excluded at S6. Arms are dose-escalation cohorts, none a control. Exploratory TCR repertoire and NK persistence assessments relate to a cell therapy, not a pharmacological candidate.
